Фразове дієслово складається з дієслова: A phrasal verb is a verb plus a small particle (up, off, on, after, out), and together they have a new meaning: give up, look after, find out. We learn the most common ones and the main word order rule: turn it off, not turn off it.
Ira gave up chocolate for a month.
Щоденні дії: get up, wake up, put on, ta: Everyday actions: get up, wake up, put on, take off
I usually get up at seven.
Техніка: turn on / off, turn up / down: Devices: turn on / off, turn up / down
Turn off the lights when you leave.
Шукати, дізнаватися, доглядати: look for: Searching, finding out, taking care: look for, find out, look after
Можеш доглянути мого хом’ячка?: Can you look after my hamster?
Щось закінчилося або триває: run out of,: Something has run out or continues: run out of, carry on
час змінює тільки дієслово, частка лишає: the tense changes only the verb, the particle stays: get up → got up, give up → gave up

Do / Did / Have + підмет + дієслово + ча: Do / Did / Have + subject + verb + particle?
роздільні дієслова (turn on / off, put o: separable verbs (turn on / off, put on, take off, pick up, throw away): the pronoun it / them / her goes only in the middle
з іменником у роздільних дієсловах можли: with a noun, separable verbs allow both word orders
look after, look for, run out of: додато: look after, look for, run out of: the object always comes after the whole verb, even a pronoun
Займенник (it, them, her, me) з роздільн: With separable verbs a pronoun (it, them, her, me) goes between the verb and the particle. A noun can go either there or after the particle.

Час змінює тільки дієслово: The tense changes only the verb
У минулому часі змінюється лише перше сл: In the past only the first word changes: got up, gave up, found out, took off. The particle doesn’t change and never gets -ed.
